_meta.parties: composite key n: ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [n+100]*32; transport X25519 seed [n+150]*32, Ed25519 [n+200]*32. User 1, agent 2, family 4, community 5, nodes 11..15.
_meta.spec: edition-2 FedCode as verify proposes it for CC 2.6.8 (rc22); CC 2.6.1.7 thumbprint; CC 3.3.6.2 transport identity

valid.description: A user code naming only the identity: resolves through the directory.
